en.name: Sirius Black
en.ability: Each night, choose to turn into your Animagus form. In Animagus form, you can only die by execution. If you die at night, choose 2 players you learn how many are evil.

revisions.v1: Each night, choose to turn into your Animagus form. In Animagus form, you can only die by execution. If you die at night, choose 2 players you learn how many are evil.

en.flavor: You Don't Understand — There Are Things Worth Dying For!
en.firstNightReminder: Wake and ask if they would like to switch form.
en.otherNightReminder: Wake and ask if they would like to switch form. If they died in the night while human, wake to tell them to choose 2 players. Show them a 0, 1 or 2 based on if the players are evil or are horcruxes.
